Resolves #21936

The Portal’s theme switch selects the matching opening photograph on a mounted example card or Workbench tile. Cards retain selection and scroll position. A saved light preference loads the light image immediately, including classic Light. Older records with one image keep it in both themes.

Evidence: L3 (real Chromium theme switch, URL traces and retained card identity) → L3 required. Deployed Portal acceptance follows the Engine release.

## AC Evidence

| Criterion | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Theme switching, state restoration and lazy loading | `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCoverTheme.spec.mjs` uses the real Portal control, search results and a scrolled Grid Tree card. It traces actual image requests and retains the selected card’s DOM identity. |
| Honest fallback | The browser sees the Sprint Board’s base JPEG and makes zero requests for its absent light sibling. The List unit tests cover both JPEG and PNG names and missing-image records. |
| Publication | All 61 light/dark pairs are live. Anonymous GETs of the 122 canonical URLs matched the bytes of [deployed Pages revision eb11df6](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/actions/runs/45030138441). The 49 component tiles and 12 full-example pairs were reviewed in [#174](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/174), [#169](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/169), [#171](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/171), [#172](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/172) and [#175](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/175). |
| Catalog integrity | Cross-checked the 61 record IDs and base paths against the reviewed batches. Removing those 61 new booleans reproduces every value and record order of the integrated 148-record catalog. The published-image baseline contains 143 distinct records. #21942 tracks its remaining 82. |

## Deltas from ticket

The catalog moved to its per-group files while this PR was open. The follow-on activation for #21949 is included here so CI and review run once. Each enabled record adds one boolean. Capture instructions and picture assets stay outside this change. Sales Pipeline and Gantt Task Tree are separate, newly authored records with their own published pairs.

## Test Evidence

55 focused Portal unit checks and four Chromium journeys passed against the grouped catalog. The theme build and `git diff --check` passed. A prior combined Portal run passed 33/34. The existing 390 × 844 overview-height assertion also failed on the unmodified base in one of two isolated runs (457 px measured against 422 px). Its assertion stays intact.

## Cold look

Frame critique: the unpaired Sprint Board retains its dark image inside the light Portal. Its footer stays white. The adjacent paired Swimlanes cover switches to the light board. In Forms & Fields the same 24 visible tiles keep their positions and labels while their captured controls switch palettes. The comparison uses the Board group's resting opening and the same settled scroll to the first field tiles in both Forms views.

**Look read by the design seat (not the cross-family review). The switch works and the paired card is right. One revision, and it is a deletion: an unpaired card keeps the light surface it has on `dev`. The dark surface for unpaired cards was my instruction, and it rested on a stale premise.**

Read at the frames of `eb204b6ff1`: the Task Board group in Neo Light at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844.

**What happened.** On 22 Nov I wrote into #21140 that a record with only a dark cover "keeps it on a dark card surface until its light partner exists", from a board of 21 Nov on which every card was dark in Neo Light. That same night #21829 (`78b90d9e2f`) made the card's surface light in Neo Light and removed the "a card is a picture" rule from the theme file. Since then `dev` shows every card on light chrome over its dark cover. I did not re-read `dev` before I wrote the instruction; you built what it said.

**What the frames show.** [The pair](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/3f65283863ae43bbe47371f0ff7728b732e21923/review-evidence/21140/c-look-2026-11-22/compare-with-21940.jpg?raw=true): above, `dev` `3766834958` in Neo Light with the Swimlanes cover swapped for its light partner and nothing else changed (a headless sketch); below, this pull request's frame. Above, three cards share one chrome and differ only in their screenshots. Below, the page has two kinds of card, and the unpaired majority got darker than it is on `dev` today. During a rollout that pairs a few records per group, the page below is the one a visitor of Neo Light would see for weeks.

![dev's light chrome with one light cover, above this pull request's frame](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/3f65283863ae43bbe47371f0ff7728b732e21923/review-evidence/21140/c-look-2026-11-22/compare-with-21940.jpg?raw=true)

**The revision, one push:**

1. In Neo Light every card keeps the surface and text `dev` gives it. The rule for `.neo-list-item:not(.portal-example-paired-cover)` goes, and with it `--portal-examples-list-single-surface` and `--portal-examples-list-single-text`.
2. A paired card swaps its image, as it does now. Its light pill values stay if the pill sits on the cover.
3. The spec asserts the image and no longer a dark surface on the unpaired card.

Then the frame at 1440 × 900 in Neo Light, once more. I read it the turn it arrives and correct the sentence in #21140's body now. No third round from me.
